name: app-black-learning-app-on-tilted-phone
title: Learning app on a tilted silver phone against black with a dark shelf edge
whatItIs: A silver phone tilted against black, its screen showing 'Welcome Back', a notched black 'Industrial Design UX' card with a See Detail aqua tab, 75% active learners, Quick Send avatars and a Homework list, with a dark shelf edge at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Sleek and focused; the notched card is the memorable component.
techniques: Notch a card corner to hold an action.
Use aqua for the active tab and bar.
Let the shelf ground the phone.

vocabulary.definition: A card with a cut corner holding a button.
A small action tab in the notch.
A dark ledge under a floating object.
